polls.description: Escalating tensions between US and China over AI technology with China blocking Meta deals, US banning chip sales, and companies scrambling for alternatives.
polls.question: Are these tech export controls necessary security measures or economic warfare?

cluster_stories.title: China’s Meta Backlash Renders Manus Model ‘Officially Dead’
cluster_stories.summary: The AI startup Manus, once hailed as a breakthrough that would challenge Silicon Valley’s dominance, is turning into a cautionary tale for Chinese entrepreneurs after Beijing authorities ordered Meta Platforms Inc. to unwind its $2 billion takeover of the company.
cluster_stories.headline: CHINA KILLS MANUS AI STARTUP... META BACKLASH INTENSIFIES

cluster_stories.title: China threatens the EU with broad retaliation if Huawei and ZTE are banned from European networks
cluster_stories.summary: Beijing’s commerce ministry has formally submitted a 30-page document warning the European Commission that its draft Cybersecurity Act, which would make vendor removal mandatory for the first time, could trigger reciprocal measures against European companies in China. China has formally threatened the European Union with retaliation if a sweeping new cybersecurity law leads to the […] This story continues at The Next Web
cluster_stories.headline: CHINA THREATENS EU Over Huawei/ZTE Ban

cluster_stories.title: Meta to backtrack acquisition of AI firm Manus after China block: report
cluster_stories.summary: Meta is reportedly reversing its acquisition of AI startup Manus. China has banned the deal, citing national security. The AI agent was founded in China but is now based in Singapore. Meta stated the transaction complied with law. Analysts had warned of regulatory issues amid US-China tech rivalry.
cluster_stories.headline: CHINA BLOCKS Meta AI Acquisition... Security Concerns

cluster_stories.title: China blocks Zuck’s acquisition of AI outfit Manus
cluster_stories.summary: Back to the drawing board for Meta's AI ambitions China has blocked Meta’s acquisition of AI upstart Manus.…
cluster_stories.headline: CHINA BLOCKS ZUCK'S AI ACQUISITION... META DEAL DEAD

cluster_stories.title: Huawei’s AI chip sales surge as Nvidia stalls in China
cluster_stories.summary: Chinese tech companies place large orders for the Shenzhen-based group’s latest range of AI processors
cluster_stories.headline: HUAWEI AI Chip Sales SURGE as Nvidia Blocked in China

cluster_stories.title: US orders chip equipment companies to halt some shipments to China's No. 2 chipmaker Hua Hong
cluster_stories.summary: America has moved to curb China's chip ambitions. The US Commerce Department has directed chip equipment companies to stop sending tools to Hua Hong. This action targets facilities believed to be producing China's most advanced chips. Top US suppliers are reportedly among those notified. The move aims to protect America's technological lead.
cluster_stories.headline: US BANS Chip Equipment Sales to China's Hua Hong

cluster_stories.title: Big Chinese tech firms scramble to secure Huawei AI chips after DeepSeek V4 launch
cluster_stories.summary: Amidst the growing competition in artificial intelligence, Chinese tech behemoths are racing to secure Huawei's Ascend 950 AI chips. The urgency follows the debut of DeepSeek's V4 AI model, designed to optimize Huawei's cutting-edge hardware. Giants like ByteDance, Tencent, and Alibaba are urgently sourcing new chip supplies, signaling a significant movement away from American semiconductor reliance.
cluster_stories.headline: CHINESE TECH GIANTS SCRAMBLE for Huawei AI Chips

cluster_stories.title: China’s Mao-era regulator in a stand-off with Meta over AI
cluster_stories.summary: National Development Reform Commission is becoming Beijing’s chief enforcer
cluster_stories.headline: CHINA'S MAO-ERA REGULATOR In Stand-Off With Meta Over AI

cluster_stories.title: Beijing’s blunt message to its tech sector
cluster_stories.summary: China’s ban on Meta-Manus deal is a warning to keep AI innovations at home
cluster_stories.headline: CHINA BLOCKS META Deal - Keeps AI Innovations at Home

cluster_stories.title: China’s decision to block the $2 billion Meta-Manus deal shows how far Washington and Beijing are drifting apart over AI
cluster_stories.summary: Both Washington and Beijing now seek to maintain control of strategic technologies and prevent them from leaking to the other.
cluster_stories.headline: CHINA BLOCKS $2B Meta-Manus AI DEAL... US-China Tech War Escalates

polls.description: Anthropic's massive $900B valuation funding round amid global security alerts over its Mythos AI system.
polls.question: Should Anthropic proceed with its $900B funding despite Mythos security concerns?

cluster_stories.title: Euro-Area Finance Chiefs to Discuss Mythos as Concerns Mount
cluster_stories.summary: Euro-area finance ministers will discuss the challenges that Anthropic PBC’s Mythos AI model poses as officials struggle to get clarity on the new tool’s powers.
cluster_stories.headline: EU FINANCE CHIEFS EMERGENCY MEETING On Anthropic Mythos

cluster_stories.title: Anthropic Considering Funding Offers at Over $900 Billion Value
cluster_stories.summary: Anthropic PBC has begun weighing a fresh funding round that would value the artificial intelligence developer at more than $900 billion, according to people familiar with the matter, potentially leapfrogging its longtime rival OpenAI as the world’s most valuable AI startup.
cluster_stories.headline: ANTHROPIC EYES $900 BILLION VALUATION... FUNDING TALKS BEGIN

cluster_stories.title: NSA Testing Anthropic’s Mythos to Find Flaws in Microsoft Tech
cluster_stories.summary: The National Security Agency has been testing the capabilities of Anthropic PBC’s new artificial intelligence model to find cybersecurity vulnerabilities in popular software, including Microsoft Corp. products, according to a US official and another person familiar with the matter.
cluster_stories.headline: NSA TESTS Anthropic's Mythos to Hunt Microsoft Vulnerabilities

cluster_stories.title: Sources: Anthropic potential $900B+ valuation round could happen within 2 weeks
cluster_stories.summary: Anthropic is asking investors to submit allocations for the AI company’s latest fundraise within the next 48 hours, according to sources familiar with the matter.
cluster_stories.headline: ANTHROPIC SEEKS $900B VALUATION... INVESTORS HAVE 48 HOURS

cluster_stories.title: Why Anthropic’s Mythos Is Sparking Global Alarm
cluster_stories.summary: Anthropic PBC has said its new artificial intelligence tool, Mythos, is so good at finding vulnerabilities in software and computer systems that it can’t be released to the general public. The AI giant released Mythos to a limited number of carefully chosen parties because if a tool this powerful fell into the wrong hands, Anthropic says, it could help attackers more easily steal data or disrupt critical infrastructure.
cluster_stories.headline: ANTHROPIC'S MYTHOS TOO DANGEROUS... Global Security Alert

cluster_stories.title: Anthropic Plan to Expand Mythos Access Is Opposed by White House
cluster_stories.summary: The White House opposes a plan by Anthropic PBC to expand access to its Mythos AI model, an administration official said Wednesday night.
cluster_stories.headline: WHITE HOUSE OPPOSES Anthropic Mythos Expansion

cluster_stories.title: Sources: Anthropic could raise a new $50B round at a valuation of $900B
cluster_stories.summary: The maker of Claude has received multiple pre-emptive offers at valuations in the $850 billion to $900 billion range, according to sources familiar with the matter.
cluster_stories.headline: ANTHROPIC Eyes $50B Round at $900B Valuation... MASSIVE

cluster_stories.title: Pentagon inks deals with seven AI companies for classified military work
cluster_stories.summary: OpenAI, Google, Nvidia and others agreed to ‘any lawful use’ of their tech. Anthropic, feuding with Pentagon over potential AI misuse, was not includedSign up for the Breaking News US email to get newsletter alerts in your inboxThe Pentagon said on Friday it had reached agreements with seven leading artificial intelligence (AI) companies: SpaceX, OpenAI, Google, Nvidia, Reflection, Microsoft and Amazon Web Services.“These agreements accelerate the transformation toward establishing the United States military as an AI-first fighting force and will strengthen our warfighters’ ability to maintain decision superiority across all domains of warfare,” the Pentagon said in statement. Continue reading...
cluster_stories.headline: PENTAGON INKS Classified AI Deals... Anthropic EXCLUDED

cluster_stories.title: Anthropic is considering a funding round that would value it at over $900 billion
cluster_stories.summary: The company is entertaining offers for approximately $50 billion at a valuation of $850–$900 billion, with a board decision expected in May and a potential IPO as early as October 2026. Anthropic has begun weighing a fresh funding round at a valuation of more than $900 billion, according to Bloomberg, which cited people familiar with […] This story continues at The Next Web
cluster_stories.headline: ANTHROPIC EYES $900 BILLION VALUATION in New Funding Round

cluster_stories.title: White House opposes Anthropic’s plan to expand Mythos access to 70 companies, citing compute and security concerns
cluster_stories.summary: The Trump administration has told Anthropic it disagrees with a controlled rollout that would bring its dangerous cyberattack-capable AI to roughly 120 organisations in total, even as the White House simultaneously explores an executive order to bring Anthropic back into federal government use. The White House has told Anthropic it opposes the company’s plan to […] This story continues at The Next Web
cluster_stories.headline: WHITE HOUSE BLOCKS Anthropic's Cyberattack AI Expansion
